# LunaEngine

> A modern 2D game framework crafted entirely in Python, designed to streamline game development by abstracting the complexities of Pygame, OpenGL, and OpenAL.

LunaEngine provides a robust collection of built-in systems, including a sophisticated UI, advanced rendering capabilities, particle effects, dynamic lighting, audio management, networking, data storage, theming, debugging tools, and numerous utilities. Born from a passion for game creation, LunaEngine empowers developers to build engaging 2D experiences with elegance and efficiency.

## Getting Started

- [Quick Start Guide](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine/quick-start.html): Get up and running with LunaEngine in minutes
- [Installation](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/LunaEngine#installation): Install via pip from PyPI or TestPyPI
- [Examples Hub](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine/examples/): Browse practical examples of LunaEngine in action

## Core Modules

- [Core Systems](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine/core/): Engine, Window, Renderer, and main loop
- [User Interface](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine/ui/): Buttons, layouts, themes, and UI components
- [Graphics & Rendering](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine/graphics/): Sprites, lighting, particles, and shaders
- [Utilities](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine/utils/): Math helpers, threading, performance monitoring
- [Renderer Backends](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine/backend/): OpenGL and Pygame backends
- [Storage](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine/storage/): Atlas, encryption, and data serialization
- [Development Tools](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine/tools/): Documentation and analysis tools
- [Miscellaneous](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine/misc/): Debugging tools and built-in assets
